Qualifying Requirements (QR) for Procurement of Oil Free Screw Compr essors for Instrument Air System & Transport Air System of DAES The bidders who wish to participate in the bidding process shall meet the requirements stipulated hereu nder: 1.0 Technical Requirement: 1.1 The bidder should be a manufacturer of Oil Free Screw Air Compressor. 1.2 The bidder should have executed Similar Order(s) during the preceding 7(seven) years reckoned as o n the date of techno-commercial bid opening in the following manner: a) Single Order of value not less than Rs 95.496 Lakhs excluding taxes & duties. OR b) Two Orders each of value not less than Rs 59.685 Lakhs excluding taxes & duties. OR c) Three Orders each of value not less than Rs 47.748 Lakhs excluding taxes & duties. 2.0 Financial Requirement: 2.1 The average annual turnover of the Bidder should not be less than Rs 119.37 Lakhs during the prec eding three (03) financial years as on scheduled date of techno-commercial bid opening. Notes for QR: I. The phrase "similar order" means: The Bidder should have supplied at least one no. of oil free screw air compressor along with dryer, each of capacity 1080 CFM or above, at rated discharge pressure of 8.5 kg/cm² or above, which are in successf ul operation for at least two (2) years during the last 07 years as on the date of techno-commercial bid op ening. II. Values as per clause 1.2 and 2.1 shall be considered exclusive of taxes & duties. III. Other income shall not be considered for arriving at annual turnover. IV. In case where audited results for the last preceding financial year as on the date of techno-commercia l bid opening are not available, the financial results certified by a Practicing Chartered Accountant shall b e considered acceptable. In case, Bidder is not able to submit the Certificate from practicing Chartered A ccountant certifying its financial parameters, the audited results of three consecutive financial years proc eeding the last financial year shall be considered for evaluating the financial parameters. Further, a Certif icate would be required from the CEO/ CFO/ Proprietor/ Partners as per the format enclosed in the biddin g documents stating that the financial results of the Company are under audit as on the date of techno-co mmercial bid opening and the Certificate from the practicing Chartered Accountant certifying the financia l parameters are not available. Bidders are required to furnish the details of the past experience like authentic Work Orders/Purchase Orders/Letter of Awards/Contract Agreements, client certificates, completion certificate, etc. in support of meeting the Qualifying Requirements based on which selection is to be made as per format in Atta chment -3 FORM FOR QUALIFICATION DETAILS (mandatory). However, if any of the Work Orders/ Purchase Orders/Letter of Awards/Contract Agreements pertains to the work executed by Bidder for NS PCL in the past, then in respect of such Work Orders/Purchase Orders/Letter of Awards/Contract Agree ments, Bidder shall not be required to enclose Client Certificate along with its Bid.

i) All the bidders, who are required to submit the details of the past experiences, shall submit all the doc uments, in support of Technical Qualification Requirements (such as copy of Purchase Orders/ Work Orde rs/ Contract Agreements/ Client Certificates etc.), duly certified and verified for authenticity from Indepen dent Statutory Auditor of their Company or specified Third-Party Inspection Agency (TPIA). (Amin) 18) RSJ Inspection Service Limited (RSJ) The following website may be referred for contact details of above eighteen (18) TPIAs: http://nabcb.qci.org.in/accreditation/reg_bod_inspection_bodies.php Any document pertaining to reference works/ plants in support of Technical QR, which is not certified by specified TPIA or Statutory Auditor of the bidder, as per the format enclosed with the bidding documents, shall not be considered verified/ certified for the purpose of evaluation, and the bid shall be liable for reje ction. (iv) The Bidder shall be responsible to get their documents/ credentials in support of Qualifying Requirem ents verified & certified by their Statutory Auditor(s) and/ or specified TPIAs. All the costs pertaining to thir d party verification and certification (including those by statutory auditors) shall be borne by the Bidder. Warranty will be limited to repair/replace of defective parts agains t manufacturing defects. Bidder has to comply the Performance/ Functional Guarantee. Also, it is t he sole responsibility of the supplier of Compressor to address any O&M related issues post-deliver y as well as spares requirement within warranty period. 4. Make in India certificate of tendered item should be from OEM 6. Interchangeability/ Fitment Guarantee: Fitment to the available space needs to be ensured by th e Agency. 7. Documents required with Bid for Technical Bid evaluation: Vendors are requested to submit foll owing document with their technical Bid: 7.1 Unpriced Techno-commercial offer 7.2 Technical Data Sheet 7.3 G.A./ C.S Drawing and/ OR Assembly Drawing 7.4 Related Technical Spec sheets (Containing Exclusion List, commissioning procedure and requir ement from Customer) 7.5 Mandatory Spare Parts List (If any) 7.6 Endorsed Nil-Deviation certificate, tender document and SPC. 8. Documents required along with material Supply: a. Guarantee/ warranty certificate. b. MDCC c. O&M Manual (Hard or Soft)

9. Drawing and QP Approval by NSPCL: 9.1 Successful bidder shall submit Civil Foundation details along with weight of the compressor pa ckage, dimensions of the unit within 15 days from receipt of firm order. 9.2 Successful bidder has to submit their manufacturing quality plan for NSPCL approval and all m ajor components are to be included in quality plan. The Quality Plan should also have performance test procedure. 10. Payment Terms: 10.1 85% payment within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of the material and documents at NSPCL Site Stores, 10.2 5% payment shall be release only after successful submission /Acceptance of PBG at NSPCL. 10.3 10% payment after successful commissioning and trial run of the compressor. If commissioni ng not done within 3 months from the date receipt of compressor at site due to reasons pertaining to NSPCL then 10 % payment will be released with submission of BG of equivalent amount. Validit y of the BG will be for next 6 Months. No additional Payment shall be reimbursed for deputation of Vendor's representative at Site during supervision of erection, commissioning and trial run. 11. Delivery period: Delivery is as per bid schedules. However, the vendor must endeavour to sup ply material at the earliest. 12. Additional Information: 12.1 Bidder has to provide supervision of erection, commissioning and trial run. Deputation charg es of the supplier's technical representatives for supervision of installation and commissioning of t he supplied air compressor package shall be included in the quoted price. Lodging & Boarding exp enses for supplier's technical representatives shall be borne by the vendor. 12.2 Items to quoted strictly, as per Item long text. In case of any ambiguity only Long text of eac h material to be referred. 12.3 Any deviations in material specifications have to be clarified prior to bid submission, any clari fications post bid opening will not be acceptable.
